Todd is the first AI-powered agriculture company designed for sustainable farming, blending agronomy research with technology. We focus on balancing and remineralizing soil, improving surrounding environments and improving health through mineral rich vegetables and fruit. We explore any territory in pursuit of an idea, taking unconventional approaches and making big, bold decisions in unexpected ways. Our internships offer the chance to make a direct impact at Todd and contribute to Todd’s growth journey.


We will win for two reasons:



- There is no other company doing this (yet)
- You can tell the CEO he’s wrong


About the role:


Internships are available remotely in the US within a range of teams from marketing to technology, finance or talent to name a few. You’ll generally be with Todd for 12 weeks and be fully embedded within the team. Our teams are a mix of staff-level college students and tuff 19 yr olds.


Mentorship plays a big role for our interns too — you’ll be paired with one of our senior leaders, providing coaching and support one-to-one throughout the program.


You might be a good fit if you are:



- One of the best [fill in the blank] in the world
- Crazy cracked
- You like what you do
- Down to work for the coolest startup ever


This program does not provide monetary compensation (i.e. no pay) standard. Depending on skill, compensation is an option.


This position does not support work authorization/visa sponsorship.

Our Summer Internship Program (May 31 - August 5, 2027) is designed to attract and develop future leaders. This opportunity is for individuals currently enrolled in an accredited college or university pursuing career opportunities in retail. As a Software Engineering Intern at Michaels, you will be assigned to a team and gain hands-on experience with core responsibilities, relevant projects, and professional development opportunities.

Major Activities



- Work closely with our development team to participate in design, code, and test software applications, features, and enhancements.
- Collaborate with team members to identify and solve technical challenges, troubleshoot issues, and optimize code.
- Write unit tests and assist in debugging and resolving software defects.
- Maintain clear and concise documentation of code, processes, and project updates.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including designers, product managers, and quality assurance engineers, to deliver high-quality software.
- Stay up to date with industry trends and best practices and apply new knowledge to improve project outcomes.

Other Duties As Assigned

Minimum Education



- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

Minimum Special Certifications Or Technical Skills



- Strong programming skills in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, C++, JavaScript).
- Knowledge of software development fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms.
- Problem-solving mindset and a passion for learning.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Minimum Type Of Experience The Job Requires



- GPA of 3.0 or above
- College Juniors and above
- One year of experience working in a retail environment is preferred. Retail operations experience in the specific functional area is a plus.

Other



- Previous coding projects or internship experience is a plus

Preferred Special Certifications Or Technical Skills



- Familiarity with development tools and integrated development environments (IDEs) relevant to the role, such as Visual Studio Code, Eclipse,
- Familiarity with web development technologies like HTML, CSS, and front-end JavaScript frameworks
- Understanding of database management systems (e.g., SQL, NoSQL databases)
- Knowledge of software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum) and an understanding of the software development lifecycle.
- Willingness to adapt to new technologies, tools, and methodologies as required by the internship.

Applicants in the U.S. must satisfy federal, state, and local legal requirements of the job.

About Intuitive Machines

Intuitive Machines is an innovative and cutting-edge space company making cislunar space accessible to both public and private customers. Our mission is to further science and exploration, communications, and economic progress from the Earth to the Moon and beyond. With the first commercial lunar landing in history, multiple NASA lunar missions in development, and additional private missions on our manifest, we pride ourselves in supporting our customers and the nation in paving the way to return humans to the surface of the Moon. Our world-class team includes experts in all aspects of spacecraft subsystems design, development, and test, on-orbit operations, and safety.

We are seeking a talented and motivated student to join our Software Simulation team for an internship in 2027. The Simulation and Modeling Software Intern will help develop models and build simulations that support design, analysis, and testing of flight software, GNC, and ground software as well as training for flight operations.

Responsibilities



- Build, maintain, and increase fidelity of environmental, vehicle and I/O simulation models
- Collaborate with flight software, GNC, and other subsystem engineers and subject matter experts in creating high-fidelity environment, sensor, effector, and interface models
- Create and execute simulation model verification tests
- Faster-than-real-time and real-time spacecraft simulation development and maintenance
- Hardware-in-the-loop (HWIL) simulation development and testing
- Write model unit tests and coordinate high-level testing of implemented models
- Develop and maintain Software Quality Assurance (SQA) tools
- Provide simulation support to flight software, ground software, and operations teams

The ideal candidate for the role of Simulation and Modeling Software Intern will be encouraged to take initiative in developing, maintaining, and improving simulation models, tools, and infrastructure. The position is multidisciplinary in nature as the simulation supports a number of internal customers which requires regular collaboration with other subsystem engineers for model development and technical support for simulation environments (HWIL simulations, FDIR testing, operations training, etc).

Requirements



-  Education & Experience
- Pursuing a degree an undergraduate or graduate degree in Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or related field
-  Programming Skills
- Familiarity with C, C++, and Python
- Experience working in a Linux environment

Preferred Additional Skills



-  Simulation Experience
- Experience developing 6-degrees-of-freedom (6-DOF) simulations
- Familiarity with NASA's Trick simulation framework

US EEO Statement

Intuitive Machines is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding), age, medical condition, marital or domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression and transgender status, mental disability or physical disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, citizenship, low-income status or any other status or characteristic protected by applicable law.

Summer 2027

Houston, TX

About Intuitive Machines

Intuitive Machines is an innovative and cutting-edge space company making cislunar space accessible to both public and private customers. Our mission is to further science and exploration, communications, and economic progress from the Earth to the Moon and beyond. With the first commercial lunar landing in history, multiple NASA lunar missions in development, and additional private missions on our manifest, we pride ourselves in supporting our customers and the nation in paving the way to return humans to the surface of the Moon. Our world-class team includes experts in all aspects of spacecraft subsystems design, development, and test, on-orbit operations, and safety.

About The Position

We are looking for motivated Flight Software Interns to join our software teams in support of our various spacecraft. Intuitive Machines is leading the charge to cislunar space with our Nova fleet of landers and Altus relay satellites. This internship offers hands-on experience working alongside experienced engineers at the intersection of rigor and agility. We are seeking bright, driven students eager to be part of the commercial space on and around the moon.

Responsibilities



- Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining flight software features and improvements
- Support testing and I/O performance assessments of integrated hardware/software solutions
- Collaborate with hardware design and development teams
- Help draft unit/integration tests and support high-level testing of features

Requirements



- Currently pursuing a B.S. in Computer Science or an engineering domain
- Coursework or project experience in C/C++ development
- Exposure to or interest in hardware/software integration
- Organized, thorough, and methodical approach to software quality and testing
- Strong written and oral communication skills
- Penchant for self-starting and problem solving
- Ability to work in a fast paced, high stakes environment
- A passion for spaceflight

Highly Desired



- Familiarity with serial communications protocols (RS-232, RS-422, RS-485, etc.)
- Familiarity with packetized communications protocols (IP/UDP, IP/TCP)
- Exposure to GSFC Core Flight Software (CFS) framework
- Familiarity with unit test frameworks
-  Experience with Windows and Linux based operating systems
